scope: All four enumerated Feet/0 fitting authoring records generation-ready. Male and older-base fits reuse the canonical item with per-foot controls; Nima reuses the identical shared female base and artwork with her own actual native item binding.

authoring_review.reason: Inspected original male feet with fitted complete sandals in all cardinal facings and mirrored west, independent native y/w palette and intended-size whole body. Reused the actual refined Sandals canonical source, not generated anatomy. Per-foot horizontal fit controls and editable fitted geometry preserve complete soles/straps and y950 contact; target body remains unchanged. New foot visibility exposes original skin outside straps. Native state acceptance pending full-set gate.

Inspected enlarged SEN and mirrored west footwear, original-foot overlay, neutral/y-w palette and intended-size whole body. Original body/feet/contact retained; sole bottom remains y950. Full soles and straps kept before foot restoration; real skin exposure is defined by the separate foot mask, not body-colored fill. Generated enlarged anatomy shifted and is not used: exact same-output strap and sole swatches supply material only. Native Feet-pair binding and outfit precedence remain pending full-set gate.

Inspected Sandals on the selected older-human base in SEN and mirrored west, neutral/native y-w palette and intended-size views. Captured Irudad Feet/0 is ordinary, not mutation-managed. Whole canonical footwear fitted with recorded horizontal controls at unchanged contact; original base feet and continuous soles/straps retained. This does not complete his separate mutated body/actor assembly or assert native equipment support.

Re-inspected exact shared female sandal/foot assembly and checked Nima Ruda actual Feet part 192, parent 176, manager null, laterality 0, Sandals instance 536 and identical item sprite/y-w palette. The selected unmutated female body and all artwork/masks are identical to the previously reviewed shared fit, so no redundant image generation or altered anatomy is claimed. BODY-NIMA and full NPC mutation assembly remain unfinished; native equipment acceptance pending.

palette: Native primary y / strap detail w; body tint remains independent.
limits: Named mutation body/actor assemblies remain incomplete. This closes footwear generation only, not native equipment acceptance or a mutated full character.
